notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Lookouts entry (county, agency, Removed) is about this tower. Two web searches and the cache found no build date, operator, design, photo or location check. A topo-map directory lists a Cook Fire Tower in Williamsburg County, but it returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The cached FFLOS South Carolina page is a map shell with no names. The Forest Lookouts coordinates (33.6339, -79.4769) were not checked. The story is short because the evidence is short; the system-wide facts are context, not evidence about this tower.
